query:
WITH inserted_user AS (
                            INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES ($1)
                            ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name
                            RETURNING id
                        )
                        INSERT INTO submissions (
                            user_id,
                            problem_id,
                            contest_id,
                            status,
                            start_date,
                            end_date
                        ) VALUES (
                            (SELECT id FROM inserted_user),
                            (SELECT id FROM problems WHERE name = $2),
                            $3,
                            $4,
                            $5,
                            $6
                        )
